purpose: Teach: ガーデニング/セーフ/ニヤニヤ/エレガント/お決まり/打てる/アシ/小さかっ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、最近、ガーデニング部、入ったって、聞いたよ。
lines.en: Riku, I heard you joined the gardening club recently.
lines.style: Light, teasing opening. Leans in with genuine curiosity. Casual pace, the tone of someone testing new conversational ground with someone she's known a while.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。テストの結果、ぎりぎりセーフで、合格、できた。
lines.en: Yeah. I barely passed the test to get in.
lines.style: Dry, self-deprecating. Quick delivery on the admission. Slight smile in the voice — not ashamed, just stating the obvious. Meets her energy without making it a big thing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、私のこと、見て、ニヤニヤ、しないでよ。
lines.en: Don't give me that look. Don't smirk at me.
lines.style: Sharp but not unkind. Catches him mid-expression. Alert, slightly defensive energy — she knows what he's thinking and she's calling him out. Light exasperation underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 昨日のパーティ、お前、めっちゃエレガントだったよ、桜。
lines.en: You looked really elegant yesterday at that party, Sakura.
lines.style: Softer pivot. Genuine compliment, but he's slightly mortified by saying it out loud. Quieter on her name. Not quite meeting her eyes in the voice — sincerity paired with embarrassment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 放課後のお決まり、コンビニで、お菓子買うんだよね。
lines.en: So the usual after-school routine — we hit up the convenience store for snacks, right?
lines.style: Brighter energy. Animated but not performing. She's bringing them back to familiar ground. Light, easy pacing — the rhythm of an established habit being named.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 野球部、お前、ホームラン、打てる時、あるんだろ?
lines.en: So you can hit home runs in baseball sometimes, huh?
lines.style: Playful jab wrapped in a question. He's fishing for something — testing whether she'll bite. Dry tone, steady pace. Not mean-spirited, just probing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭、アシスタントとして、私、手伝うんだ。
lines.en: I'm going to help out as an assistant for the culture festival.
lines.style: Shift to earnest. She means this. Straightforward delivery, slightly slower pace. The voice settles into something more grounded — this matters to her and she's saying it plainly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 幼稚園の頃、お前、本当に小さかったよな、写真で見たわ。
lines.en: You were so tiny back in kindergarten — I saw it in a photo.
lines.style: Gentle teasing, almost affectionate. Slightly softer than his earlier barbs. He's accessing a shared memory, comfortable enough to be a little sentimental. Warmth underneath the wry delivery.
